text.p: These were the headlines on Latvian state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The ruling parties are to meet Prime Minister Andris Shkele today and inform him that they want to form a new government. It is still unclear whether Shkele will resign.
- Shkele will hold a press conference after the meeting.

- President Guntis Ulmanis is to rush back from a trip to Liepaja and will also hold a press conference to give his views of the political troubles. Ulmanis has already given his full backing to Shkele.
